summary: Compilation of three Better Offline episodes in which Ed Zitron blames Google executive Prabhakar Raghavan for degrading Google Search, profiles OpenAI CEO Sam Altman as a manipulative hype man, and indicts the tech industry and press.

evidence.note: Google search story opens with the February 2019 Code Yellow over search revenue
Raghavan ran Yahoo Search from 2005 to 2012, the earliest period covered at length
Altman's arrival in Silicon Valley around 2005 and his Y Combinator start
March 2019 core update and ad redesign framed as making search worse for revenue
OpenAI safety resignations, board firing and AI hype discussed at length
third episode argues legacy media failed to hold tech and the powerful to account
Bloomberg reporter on the Foundering season about Altman joins as interview guest
effects framed as global: search and AI products used by billions
extended rant on managers versus workers; later blames layoffs and 'lazy worker' coverage
AI bubble, venture capital disconnection and Altman's angel-investing wealth discussed at length
